entities.name: The Maker
entities.description: God of Cridhe, creator of the plane, highly venerated; carved the Blessing and the Curse.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Tree said to be as old as the plane, at whose base the Maker carved a stone.

entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: Man whose line fell under the Curse after he split the stone during the Parting.

entities.name: Parting
entities.description: Event in which Nohr split the Maker's stone.

entities.name: Gwylfan
entities.description: Group the Maker placed at Loch Prith to weave prophecies and teachings.

entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: Place where the Maker placed the Gwylfan.

events.summary: The Maker carves the Blessing and the Curse on a stone at the base of the young Clan Tree.
events.quote: the Maker carved a message in ornate letters onto a stone at its base

events.summary: The Maker places the Gwylfan at Loch Prith.
events.quote: the Maker placed the Gwylfan at Loch Prith

events.summary: Nohr splits the stone during the Parting and the Curse falls on his line.
events.quote: The Curse fell on the line of Nohr
